title: known positive: npm ci with no cache anywhere in the job

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

name: CI

          path: ~/.npm

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: npm ci --prefix web

  push:
    tags: ['v*']
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
